projects.description: AI search and research platform under active development. The repo documents keyword, semantic, hybrid, and AI-assisted search — not a finished product.
lines: # LUMO
### AI search and research platform under active development. The repo documents keyword, semantic, hybrid, and AI-assisted search — not a finished product.
LUMO is one of my main projects: an AI-powered search and research platform
that is still under active development. The repository contains a FastAPI
backend and a vanilla JavaScript frontend. Documented areas include keyword
search, semantic search, hybrid retrieval, AI-assisted answers,
source-oriented research workflows, a multi-provider AI router (Gemini,
Grok, and Ollama), a knowledge graph, and a download-guardian area for URL
and file checks. Those areas exist in the codebase as modules. They should
be read as in-progress work, including experimental and planned research
pieces, not as a production search engine.
Built with Python · FastAPI · JavaScript · SQLAlchemy
[Visit](https://github.com/midhunkrishnan-131/lumo-search-platform)

projects.description: Development project for an AI-assisted Windows security assessment workspace. Not all parts are implemented or production-ready.
lines: # MYX AI
### Development project for an AI-assisted Windows security assessment workspace. Not all parts are implemented or production-ready.
MYX AI (Windows Edition) is a development project around authorized Windows
security assessment and security analysis. The repository includes a React
19 and TypeScript frontend, a FastAPI and SQLAlchemy backend, PostgreSQL
with pgvector, Gemini integration, and a Windows agent package. Documented
pieces include website, network, and Wi-Fi assessment concepts,
evidence-backed findings, CVSS v3.1 scoring, SSRF and private-network
guards, cloud-metadata protection, URL checks, SPF and DMARC parsing, and
RBAC tests. A status note in the repo separates completed, scaffolded, and
runtime-dependent work. This is not a production security product.
Built with React · TypeScript · FastAPI · Python · PostgreSQL · Gemini · SQLAlchemy
[Visit](https://github.com/midhunkrishnan-131/myx-ai-windows)

projects.description: AI-assisted Python debugging with a complete-answer mode, a Socratic hint mode, and isolated execution.
lines: # CodeDoctor AI
### AI-assisted Python debugging with a complete-answer mode, a Socratic hint mode, and isolated execution.
CodeDoctor AI is an AI-assisted coding and debugging project. It includes a
React and TypeScript interface with Monaco Editor, a FastAPI backend,
isolated Python execution with configurable timeouts, loop protection,
memory limits, and standard-input support, plus code-health checks, anomaly
detection, diagnosis history, and session restore. AI diagnosis has a
complete-answer mode and a Socratic logic-hint mode, with Groq and a Gemini
fallback.
Built with React · TypeScript · Monaco Editor · FastAPI · Python · Groq API · SQLite
[Visit](https://github.com/midhunkrishnan-131/CodeDoctor--AI)

projects.description: Instrumented experiments for image understanding, speech, latency, and an STT-to-LLM-to-TTS pipeline.
lines: # Multimodal Benchmark
### Instrumented experiments for image understanding, speech, latency, and an STT-to-LLM-to-TTS pipeline.
Multimodal Pipeline Benchmark measures vision, speech, and latency. It
covers image-understanding experiments, image resolution and cost
experiments, speech transcription, speech generation, and end-to-end voice
workflows. Recorded measurements include image-token usage, estimated cost,
chunked transcription latency, word error rate against a manual reference,
and streaming TTS time-to-first-audio. It also compares sequential and
concurrent STT-to-LLM-to-TTS pipelines and includes deterministic
failure-handling demonstrations.
Built with Python · OpenAI API
[Visit](https://github.com/midhunkrishnan-131/multi_model)

lines: # DevAssist
### Engineering-focused CLI LLM client with multi-turn chat, streaming, retries, and validated tool calls.
DevAssist is a command-line LLM client. The published client uses the OpenAI
API, with multi-turn conversation history, a stateless request
demonstration, streamed responses, token and cost reporting, context
trimming, retries on 429 and 5xx responses, JSON-schema invoice extraction,
and a validated calculator tool call. Built with Python and Pydantic.
Built with Python · OpenAI API · Pydantic

projects.description: Reusable REST client with session reuse, retries, structured logging, and generator-based pagination.
lines: # API Client
### Reusable REST client with session reuse, retries, structured logging, and generator-based pagination.
Production-Grade API Client is a reusable Python REST client. It reuses a
requests session, retries 429 and 5xx responses with exponential backoff and
jitter, honors Retry-After, logs in a structured form, validates environment
configuration, fails fast on other 4xx responses, and paginates with a
generator. Dependencies include Requests and python-dotenv.
Built with Python · Requests · python-dotenv
[Visit](https://github.com/midhunkrishnan-131/api-client-project)
